mapper.select: Select A.user_email As userEmail, A.user_id AS userId, A.password As password, A.user_name As username, A.group_id As groupId, A.group_role As groupRole, B.group_nm As groupName FROM smartbusmngdb.sbm_operator_user A JOIN smartbusmngdb.sbm_operator B WHERE A.user_email = #{userEmail} and A.confirmed_user = 'Y' and A.group_id = B.group_id and A.withdraw_yn = 'N'
